title: Genetic ancestry, time to tumour sequencing and survival in MSK-IMPACT 50K and MSK-CHORD: reproducibility code
description: Code to reproduce the numbers, tables and figures of the manuscript "Genetic ancestry, time to tumour sequencing and survival in clinical sequencing cohorts: an integrated analysis of MSK-IMPACT 50K and MSK-CHORD with delayed-entry correction". The code builds the integrated dataset from the public cBioPortal files and runs all analyses in Python, with independent checks in R and Stata. No patient-level data are redistributed.
